description: The two topics of art and nature have many similarities and differences. Nature is filled with organic and natural beauty, which can be seen in landscapes and wildlife. Art is a human creation that can be expressed by painting, sculpture, photography, music, and many other mediums. Nature is an unmutable force of the world, while art is an ever-evolving form of expression that is shaped by culture and personal interpretations.
